title: Extend the extract-function app with a shared validators module and multiple new handlers
description: Long-horizon task on refactor_extract_function: create a shared validators module with email, phone, and username validation; extend handlers with handle_registration and handle_profile_update; extend models with validate_user_record_extended. All existing tests must pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement four new additions across three files:

1. Create src/validators.py:
   - is_valid_email(email: str) -> bool  (reuse regex from handlers/models)
   - validate_phone(phone: str) -> bool  (7+ digit pattern: r'^\+?[\d\s\-(). ]{7,}$')
   - validate_username(username: str) -> bool  (3-20 chars, alphanumeric + underscore: r'^\w{3,20}$')

2. Add to src/handlers.py (import from src.validators):
   - handle_registration(email, name, phone) -> dict
     Validates email and phone, returns {user, email, phone}
   - handle_profile_update(user_id: int, email: str, username: str) -> dict
     Validates email and username, returns {user_id, email, username}

3. Add to src/models.py (import from src.validators):
   - validate_user_record_extended(record: dict) -> bool
     Checks email (via is_valid_email) AND username (via validate_username if present)

All 6 existing tests must still pass.
Add tests/test_extended.py covering the new functions.
required_artifacts: validate_user_record_extended checks email and optional username
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (all tests)
uv run python -c "from src.handlers import handle_signup" passes
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.handlers import handle_signup"
